title: 选择 Interview Book 的第二轮视觉方向
question: 上一轮已按你的操作重新抽取并排除旧方向。现在对比这组全新方向；选定后我会再制作三版构图 comp。

options.label: The Question Field Guide
options.lineage: Professional field guides and compact classification keys
options.thesis: A clear subject key leads to each open question and the capability it is meant to explore.
options.viewport: Visible search leads; a compact key names the capability domains; one question record shows its purpose and related subjects.
options.case: The field-guide taxonomy fits independent exploration while giving every question a clear subject and observation note.
options.risk: It could feel like a training manual; keep the heading literal and make search the first action.

raised.raise: Plain-language first: a direct question and readable purpose label carry meaning without mascots or explanatory cartoons.
Explicit state labels: active filters and current selections always use text, never color alone.
Reversible navigation: every topic route returns to a stable, shareable question index.
No commerce metaphor: omit inventory, variant, ownership, and product-selection cues.

options.label: The Conversation Prompt Deck
options.lineage: Facilitator prompt decks and open conversation cards
options.thesis: Each prompt remains self-contained, with its purpose printed beside it for reflection or discussion.
options.viewport: Search sits above a sparse column of question prompts, each paired with a small purpose note and topic label.
options.case: The everyday prompt format is immediately understandable across candidates, interviewers, and promotion reflection.
options.risk: Literal card tiles are a familiar interface cliché; the layout must stay editorial and avoid a game feel.

options.label: The Design Annual Plate Index
options.lineage: Design annual plate sections with registration marks and clear attribution
options.thesis: Questions read as carefully registered editorial plates with source and subject kept distinct.
options.viewport: A precise index and featured question sit on one aligned sheet; compact attribution is separated from intent.
options.case: A strong grid and source-conscious editorial treatment work well for a curated bilingual reference.
options.risk: Could become a print portfolio rather than a practical question site if the index is too quiet.

options.label: The Star Atlas Index
options.lineage: Celestial star-atlas charts with coordinate grids and indexed objects
options.thesis: Independent topic paths connect through a readable coordinate system rather than one fixed sequence.
options.viewport: Search and capability topics remain at the top; a restrained chart links topic and role paths around a featured question.
options.case: The atlas supports non-linear exploration and can make cross-links visible across a large question set.
options.risk: Constellation imagery could obscure the question and imply that readers must follow a route.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Zine Explainer
options.lineage: Marker-lettered technical zines with doodle arrows and comic panels
options.case: The mascot and sequential explainer panels imply instruction or answers, while the site is for open question exploration.
options.kept: Plain-language prompts and purpose labels that need no decorative explanation.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.lineage: Spectral emission instruments with calibrated rails and line-form states
options.case: The single rail narrows a multi-dimensional question library and is unfamiliar outside technical audiences.
options.kept: Named filter states and high-contrast labels that never rely on hue alone.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: Surreal concrete poetry where letters become changing weather
options.case: Transforming words would make stable questions harder to read and return to.
options.kept: Stable question URLs and reversible movement between topics.

options.label: Sneaker Archive Wall
options.lineage: Retail sneaker walls with stacked boxes, colorway labels, and size runs
options.case: Inventory, variants, and ownership do not describe an open question library.
options.kept: No commerce or product-variant signals in the question interface.

canonCard.label: The conventional docs site
canonCard.thesis: A straightforward documentation library with an ordinary search, topic sidebar, and question pages.
canonCard.viewport: Header, sidebar, search field, and a featured question with its purpose below.
canonCard.risk: Clear and familiar, but does little to express this question-first library.
